versions.note: from tools/music_round5.py (written for Lyria 3 Pro); its length sentence dropped, since Lyria 2 makes about 33 s
versions.prompt: Acoustic guitar finger-picking with light hand percussion (shaker, soft cajón) and a little glockenspiel now and then, bright and easy, a sunny afternoon outside. 98 BPM. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, unhurried and easy to listen to for a long time. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
versions.use: Outdoors during the day: the forecourt, the plaza and the other outdoor places.

versions.note: Round 6 feedback (day-1: super repetitive): varied melody and changing chords, sections that differ
versions.prompt: Warm acoustic guitar with a light marimba and soft brushed percussion, 100 BPM, sunny and easy. The melody and chord progression keep changing: several different short themes passed between guitar and marimba, no riff or phrase repeated more than twice, a gentle new idea every few bars. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
versions.use: Outdoors during the day: the forecourt, the plaza and the other outdoor places.

versions.note: Round 7 feedback (jungle song; percussion too hard, weird fantasy; random noises): no marimba or hand percussion, quiet soft drums, one clear simple melody on piano over guitar chords, modern Japanese pop; the "no" words moved to the negative prompt.
versions.prompt: Easy, sunny daytime music for walking around a modern Japanese town: acoustic guitar strumming soft chords and a clear, simple piano melody that is easy to hum, with soft bass and gentle, quiet drums kept in the background. Major key, 96 BPM. Cheerful and calm everyday Japanese pop, like a slice-of-life anime. Instrumental background music for a video game. It stays at one relaxed level all the way through, with no ending, so it can loop.
